conceptual assets.concept: Boot ROM contents (initialized image stored in mem_rom_c)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access process reads the stored boot image: rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(boot_rom_size_index_c+1 downto 2)))) on rising_edge(clk_i). The returned bus word is driven from that register (bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')). Therefore the values held in mem_rom_c directly determine words delivered to the bus; corruption of mem_rom_c would change responses produced by the module, violating the implemented read behavior (Integrity). mem_rom_c is the declared memory constant that stores the image.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-data register value returned to the bus (rdata)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access process updates rdata from the ROM on each rising_edge(clk_i): rdata <= mem_rom_c(...). bus_rsp_o.data is driven from rdata when rden = '1' (bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')). Thus rdata is the internal storage of the word presented on reads; incorrect or corrupted rdata would make the module return wrong data, establishing Integrity.

The bus_feedback process computes and registers the response-valid decision: if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0' elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw). The module exposes the decision as ack and gates data with it: bus_rsp_o.ack <= rden; bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0'). rden therefore defines when data and ack are produced; incorrect rden breaks the implemented acknowledge/data behavior, establishing Integrity.
